semiconductor_relevance: High — Hirose Opto Co., Ltd. specializes in optical inspection equipment crucial for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hirose Opto Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced optical inspection equipment, focusing on Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems for the semiconductor industry. Their expertise in AOI processes, particularly from the TFT-LCD industry, is being expanded to include semiconductor metrology and inspection solutions for emerging technologies like Micro/Mini LED and Micro OLED.
capabilities: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems for Array, CF, PI, ODF, and Module processes
